# Maps

**Where you are:** [Reading root](../../../README.md) › [#4 Episteme](../README.md) › Maps

Maps carries the declared structure of the work: the essay sequence, argument dependencies, concept consumers, source relations and transverse paths. Each edge names its operation — derives, grounds, defines, historicises, sources, qualifies, tests, figures, embodies, extends, compares, presages or returns-to.

Maps are built from canonical declarations. Shared words, tags and folder adjacency never create an edge. A map supplies orientation and effect tracing; it does not become authority over the proposition carried by its nodes.

## The curated paths

A path exists only where a whole transverse movement cannot be safely reconstructed from the local relations of its members. Four are ratified, each for a distinct reason:

| Path | Why it exists as a path |
|---|---|
| [Return of Zero — Braided Traversal](return-of-zero-braided-traversal.md) | The linear spine itself: all 48 movements in writing order, with the day spine and the night pressure that keeps every station answerable to the Agentworld brief. No single movement can show the order of the whole. |
| [Mono–Poly and the Two Ones](mono-poly-two-ones.md) | The ontological kernel `0 = One, 1 = All` runs from the empty set through the two logics and the eight determinations to the political and technical field. Read locally it looks like six unrelated results; the path keeps it one movement. |
| [Trust, Faith and the Formal Limit](trust-faith-formal-limit.md) | Trust passes through logic, psyche, politics, infrastructure and the agentic field without any one register defining it for the others. The path preserves that passage so trust never becomes a detachable theme. |
| [The Advent of Zero, Subject and Integral Logic](zero-subject-advent.md) | Two histories, the mathematical admission of zero and the scientific admission of the subject, are joined only by the essay's authorial operation. The path holds them side by side without collapsing them into one event. |

The three transverse threads are also declared in the frontmatter of the movements and field records they pass through (`transverse_threads`), so any member can be found from the path and the path from any member.

## The generated navigation layer

[`navigation/`](navigation/MOC.md) holds the projections generated from the relations authors wrote into pages: the [Map of Content](navigation/MOC.md), the per-class intents pages (what each page implicates and what reaches it), and the [navigation audit](navigation/AUDIT.md). They are rebuilt by `tools/build-navigation.py`, checked for freshness at session close, and carry no authority; page-level minigraphs are bounded views of this same relation set, accompanied by the same routes in prose.
